t: The Chimera floodlight combines precision lighting with a robust, function-led form. Dual adjustable LED heads deliver powerful 2350 lumens of crisp 5000K cool white light. Ideal for illuminating entrances, driveways and outdoor workspaces where extra visibility is needed. PIR sensor detects movement up to 18m away, with a wide 180° coverage zone, and offers tailored control with adjustable detection range (4–18m). Features 3 x selectable time settings (1, 3 or 10 minutes) and a dusk-to-dawn mode which automatically illuminates in the evening and turns off the following morning. Manual override for constant light when required. Engineered for durability and made from tough, corrosion-resistant polycarbonate. IP54 rated to ensure long-term performance outdoors.
